messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Incident detected: sharp 502/504 spike at eu-west inference-gateway (ingress). Error rate jumped from ~0.3% to ~17% starting 2024-06-15T21:20:30Z. Pager sent to #incidents-oncall.
elena: I’m on it — picking up pager. first check: any deploys in eu-west around 21:18Z?
ben: @elena not from infra deploys, but product rolled a routing config at 21:15Z (soft rollout).
elena: ok tagging that as suspect. @kai can you pull the gateway logs and counter rates for the last 10m?
kai: grabbing logs now. quick snippet of 502 traces: ```[2024-06-15T21:20:45Z] gw-eu1 proxy->upstream timeout ms=1201 route=/v1/embeddings status=502 client=10.8.2.45```
ben: that route is our embeddings fanout to model-pool-v2. We saw higher tail latencies earlier in the week after a quantized model switch.
elena: telemetry: 502s concentrated on /v1/embeddings and /v1/generate, not static assets. CPU on gateway nodes normal, upstream p50 latency for model pool jumped from 45ms -> 950ms.
nina: customer impact check: monitoring flagged ~45 customers with >1% error rate; top affected: AcmeCorp (webhooks), Learningly (embedding batch jobs). Sending heads-up to CS.
ben: mitigation proposals: 1) flip routing flag back to model-pool-v1, 2) enable circuit-breaker on model-pool-v2, 3) shift a portion of traffic to eu-east fallback.
elena: do 1 and 2 as atomic steps. Kai — can you run the revert script? ```scripts/routing/switch_model_pool.sh --region eu-west --target v1```
kai: running now. 21:22:10 initiating switch.
incidents-bot: Action logged: routing switch triggered by kai at 2024-06-15T21:22:12Z.
kai: circuit-breaker set to open for model-pool-v2 (fail-fast) at 21:22:20.
ben: seeing immediate drop in 502s at the gateway — error rate down to ~4% in last 2m.
elena: keep monitoring. start a traffic shift to eu-east for non-critical requests (30%)? @sre-oncall want to coordinate traffic-shift runbook.
sre-oncall: ready. executing gradual traffic-shift: set weight eu-west 70 -> 40 over 10 steps, eu-east 30 -> 60. Monitoring for client affinity issues.
kai: curl health endpoints: ```curl -s https://model-pool-v2.eu-west.internal/health || echo FAIL``` -> returns FAIL for /v1/embeddings backend. model-pool-v1 health OK.
ben: looks like v2 has degraded during quantized kernel path under certain seq lengths, it’s hitting timeouts and causing proxy 502s.
elena: current status: 502s down to 1.8%, tail latencies improving. Customers still seeing intermittent errors; CS notified.
nina: AcmeCorp reported degraded embeddings for search indexing jobs — they've paused retries on their side. Customer impact: medium; mitigation in place.
elena: plan: keep circuit-breaker open, keep traffic-shifted while we rollback model-pool-v2 release and run postmortem. Create follow-up ticket for model-team to investigate kernel/quantization edge case.
ben: opened ticket INF-4421 with logs and repro steps. tagging model-team.
nina: handing off to night shift in 30m. @sre-oncall will monitor for 2 hours then escalate if error rate >2%.
sre-oncall: acknowledged. will keep watch and reopen if trends reverse.
elena: thanks team. root cause suspected: quantized runtime causing long tail latency under some input distributions; immediate mitigation succeeded via routing revert + circuit-breaker + traffic shift. Starting incident notes now. :thumbsup:
incidents-bot: Incident marked: mitigated -> monitoring. Duration so far: ~30 minutes. Postmortem assigned: elena, ben, model-team.
